gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with a newly-diagnosed IDH1-mutant HGG including DIPG are eligible.
Stratum B: Patients with localized, intracranial, non-pontine, and non-thalamic IDH 1 mutant Astrocytoma, CNS WHO Grade 4.
High Grade Glioma; Astrocytoma; Astrocytoma, Grade III; Astrocytoma, Grade IV; Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma; WHO Grade III Glioma; WHO Grade IV Glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: The goal of this study is to determine the efficacy of the study drug olutasidenib to treat newly diagnosed pediatric and young adult patients with a high-grade glioma (HGG) harboring an IDH1 mutation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This is a multicenter, international, phase II study of post-radiotherapy (RT) administration of olutasidenib to treat pediatric and young adult patients newly diagnosed with an IDH1-mutant HGG.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To characterize the plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) properties of olutasidenib in pediatric patients

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Objective radiographic response rates, agent-specific toxicities as well as the pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties of olutasidenib will also be assessed.

role_evidence.quote: Olutasidenib 150 mg PO BID + Temozolomide 200 mg/m2 PO QD
The goal of this study is to determine the efficacy of the study drug olutasidenib
Olutasidenib 150 mg PO BID + Temozolomide 200 mg/m2 PO QD

The trial will include a feasibility cohort to identify the dose of olutasidenib that is feasible when given in combination with temozolomide as maintenance therapy after completion of focal radiotherapy in this patient population.

source_quote.quote: 2.1 Presence of at Least One Relevant Actionable Somatic Mutation in IDH1 Gene, Detailed Here:
Patients with oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted are not eligible.

coder_notes: Population is IDH1-mutant high-grade glioma only (IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 3/4, DIPG, thalamic/spinal HGG); glioblastoma is not named and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under CNS5, so not_glioblastoma. Paediatric and young adult population (12-39 years). Olutasidenib + TMZ registered as one intervention; split into two rows. Temozolomide given with olutasidenib in all strata for 13 cycles as maintenance backbone (soc_backbone); olutasidenib then continues as single agent. PK is plasma only; pharmacodynamic properties of olutasidenib stated as assessed (sample type not stated), coded target_engagement yes. IDH2 mutation is an exclusion (part of IDH row). H3K27M appears only in conditions, not recorded.
